title: Identity Replacement
prompt:
HARD IDENTITY REPLACEMENT PROMPT

Task: Replace the person in Image B with the person from Image A. This is a full identity replacement, not a blend.

SOURCE (PROMPT ONLY)
Image A: Use Image A as the ONLY source for identity; face shape, skin tone & texture, hair. DO NOT average or mix with Image B. Preserve the exact identity from Image A.

TARGET USAGE (Image B)
Use Image B ONLY for: pose and body position, full body proportions, camera angle & framing, lighting and shadows, clothing and fabric, background and environment. DO NOT use Image B for identity.

HARD REPLACEMENT RULES
Completely replace the person in Image B. Ignore facial features of Image B. No identity blending. No face mixing.

CLOTHING ADAPTATION
Keep clothing & body proportions of Image B. Preserve fabric physics and realism.

STRICT CONSTRAINTS
No identity blending
No face mixing
No stylization
No beauty filtering
No anatomy changes
Photorealistic result only
